column2: Yes. Thank you, Lord Raphael. I'll go back to the heroes now.{wait}{clear}
Take care, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}
Fein
Using even a kid like this...{wait}{clear}All he had was a special power, stronger than other people's... that boy.{wait}{clear}
Just like me, back then...{wait}{clear}
Meeting Zig saved me... but he was used by a devil, and he died...{wait}{clear}
If only I could have saved him...{wait}{clear}
...It's all right now...{wait}{clear}
You can cry...{wait}{clear}
Mom...{wait}{clear}
Ion... did you get to see your mother?{wait}{clear}
He used his own magic... to reject... my spell...{wait}{clear}
Poor thing...{wait}{clear}
All that power... and in the end he could only use it for death...{wait}{clear}
There should have been another way for Ion to live...{wait}{clear}
And yet...{wait}{clear}
he fell into a trap like that...{wait}{clear}
Evil is covering the land... We have to stop it...{wait}{clear}
Yes... It's up to us...{wait}{clear}
We must never let a tragedy like this happen again...{wait}{clear}
Angel... may I talk with you?{wait}{clear}
Of course.{wait}{clear}
What is the Heavenly Dragon doing now...?{wait}{clear}
It has attacked many countries and is making a great many people suffer...{wait}{clear}
I see...{wait}{clear}
Once again... this world is about to be covered by the shadow of death...{wait}{clear}
We have to stop the Heavenly Dragon and the devils, and soon...{wait}{clear}
A long time has passed since I left the forest with you, Angel...{wait}{clear}
I've been through... so many things, more than I could have believed...{wait}{clear}
I inherited all of the Holy Mother's memories, and overcame many battles together with you, Angel...{wait}{clear}
But...{wait}{clear}
somewhere in my heart... if only I could live an ordinary, peaceful life like when I lived in the forest...{wait}{clear}
sometimes I think how much easier it would be...{wait}{clear}
The heart those inherited memories made... rebukes me for feeling this way...{wait}{clear}
You must be angry too, Angel... that I'd have such weak feelings...{wait}{clear}
No, I think it's only natural.{n}
It's natural for people to waver.{n}
There's been too little time to accept all of it...{wait}{clear}
...Thank you.{wait}{clear}
You're so kind, Angel...{wait}{clear}
Cecia, do you truly regret it now?{wait}{clear}
No... I don't regret it.{wait}{clear}
I'm proud that I can work to protect this precious world...{wait}{clear}
Angel... the reason someone as weak as me has come this far is...{wait}{clear}
